Sociolinguistic survey (Glottolog's only reference for Kuk, cited for p. 7). p. 8 Fig. 4 groups 'Kuk: Kuk, Kumfutu'; p. 9 section KUK: 2,000-3,000 speakers in six villages (Kuk, Kumfutu, Achaf, Nzela, Echuapo, Ebo), 'Kuk is linguistically homogeneous'. No wordlist or phonology printed.
